assets.name: cookie_normal_damage_1
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one production damage-state PNG sprite for the normal cookie peg in Sugarfall. The attached PNG is the exact edit target, NOT a loose style reference. Change only physical damage. DAMAGE STAGE 1 of 3: a visibly chipped cookie after its first hit. Remove two modest angular chunks from the upper-right rim, exposing warm rough baked crumb, and add one broad short fissure extending inward from that chipped edge through icing. Missing chunks are transparent voids, not shaded intact cake. Leave about 85–90% of the cookie intact. Damage must read immediately at only 49 pixels wide: use broad 2–3-pixel-at-final-size dark fissure, not hairline texture. Preserve the cookie identity, toppings, circular center, original outer diameter, exact canvas position, camera angle, material palette, upper-left light, and original transparent safety margins. Especially retain the cream icing petals and caramel center. Do NOT zoom or recenter after removing pieces. No floating debris beyond the original silhouette. One isolated cookie only, square PNG, genuine alpha background and genuine alpha in removed chunks. No text, numbers, rings, progress bars, frame, sheet, floor, shadow, background, checkerboard or other objects.
